players.product: multimodal clinical data, diagnostics, and AI applications

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Eric Lefkofsky on the GenomeNext whole-genome launch in the Ambry hereditary / rare disease business: two or three weeks in, the launch was already 50% higher than the company's expectation for the first month, though 'these are small numbers' (500 or 1,000 tests would be a good start); he expects some whole-genome upside in the back half of the year, sees no cannibalisation of the whole exome business so far, and said the company views the hereditary business as getting to mid-teens growth by the end of the year while staying conservative on whole-genome estimates.
quarterly_data.figure: launch ~50% above first-month expectation; hereditary business viewed as getting to mid-teens growth by year-end

quarterly_data.signal: CEO Eric Lefkofsky on Personalis' MRD test: Personalis has a pipeline of studies being run that read out into papers that eventually turn into approvals (said in the context of Personalis' coverage and ASP); it has gained three approvals so far with a pipeline of others coming, and he expects the ASP story to turn in 2027. He said MRD tests show signs of cancer recurring six months or 12 months before a scan, and that biopharma clients consistently ask Tempus to include MRD data with the data they use for licensing and modeling, which he suspects will over time become a compelling component of the data offering.
quarterly_data.figure: three approvals so far; recurrence signal six months or 12 months before a scan
